**Ruled #862: the memory lane — L1–L9 ratified with two conditions; ADR-0034 and three amendments drafted; #886–#890 filed**

**What**: The maintainer ratified on 2026-09-09 the nine decisions of the #862 proposal as recommended: L1 lane class narrowly defined (head ^memory/ AND additions under .memory/records/ only, body 'Memory lane: <host> <date>', no issue); L2 merge by tier (lite auto-merge via mrAutoMerge, standard/regulated wait for a human, the verb refuses rather than pretends); L3 index off the lane (records only, index.jsonl derived, local-checks warns on lag); L4 collector by git plumbing with no checkout; L5 trigger brain:memory:ship from session-end, day:start and by hand, never from feature pre-push, credential per ADR-0033; L6 memory-gate unchanged, template wording changes; L7 retire the five feature-PR surfaces after 3.1b and #874; L8 a new ADR plus three amendments; L9 targets p50 <= 1 h, p90 <= 24 h at lite. Two conditions added: C1 the secret scrub is a required check of the lane PR before any auto-merge; C2 the collector's filename dedup is deterministic on divergence, first-wins like the reader.

**Why**: memory rides the feature PR today (p50 21.6 h, p90 399.7 h learn-to-main); #862 is Wave 1 task 1.1 of #864 and files the Wave 3 slices.

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-862-memory-lane/{explore,proposal,spec,design,tasks}.md; brain-drafts/ adr-0034-memory-travels-on-its-own-lane.md, consolidation-protocol.draft.md (Amendment 1, §5), adr-0002-amendment-2.draft.md, openspec-readme-rule-3.draft.md. Tickets filed: #886 (2.5 mrAutoMerge), #887 (3.1a collector), #888 (3.1b push + PR), #889 (3.1c path restriction, lane class, lane-scrub), #890 (3.1d retirement). Epic tasks.md carries the numbers.

**Learned**: the new-ADR draft must be named adr-NNNN-slug.md (no .draft.md) for brain:promote's DRAFT_BASENAME_RE. The collector must push --no-verify because pre-push runs memory:share; the ADR documents the bypass. Promotion of the four drafts is a separate maintainer sitting, filed as a follow-up.
